messages:
claire: Heads-up — ran a canary A/B rollout for the traffic-shaping feature and the permission gate failed to trigger fallback. Canary instances started but rollback endpoint returned 403 for the operator role.

claire: logs:
```
2026-03-19T22:14:36Z ERROR 403 "Forbidden" "caller lacks permission: rollout.rollback"
service=canary-controller instance=canary-42 pod=cc-9f
request: POST /api/v1/rollout/fallback?canary_id=abtest-17
```

josh: Which environment + service-account? Is this Hosted or Dedicated?

claire: Dedicated-prod cluster (us-east-1). Service account is ops-canary@redwood-prod. This started after last week's RBAC role flattening PR (meera)

meera: I pushed RBAC refactor last night to simplify roles. I didn't touch canary permissions explicitly — but there was a KMS key rotation at 02:10 UTC that updated key policy bindings.

meera: audit excerpt showing KMS denies:
```
2026-03-19T02:11:02Z aud=cloud-kms project=redwood-prod principal=ops-canary@redwood-prod action=CryptoDecrypt status=PERMISSION_DENIED
```

arun: If the operator run path needs to decrypt a rollout token (KMS) and the SA lost decrypt rights, the controller errors out before invoking fallback. That matches 403 on the API and missing fallback trace.

josh: Can we patch a quick mitigation? E.g., re-grant KMS:cryptoDecrypt to ops-canary SA and add fallback permission to operator role temporarily?

claire: Proposed short plan:
- add KMS decrypt grant to ops-canary SA (temporary)
- add explicit "rollout.rollback" permission on operator role
- run a small canary with 10% traffic
- verify audit logs for fallback calls
- revert temporary grants after we confirm

deploy-bot: Feature flag change detected: "perms-refactor-enforce" toggled ON by infra-bot at 1972345600

security-bot: Flagging for security triage — we need a ticket. Note: some attempted fallback requests didn't generate full audit entries because decrypt failed early (so we lack a payload-level log).

arun: I'll create the RBAC patch and the KMS grant request (will prep a IAMPR). Will also add a short test that asserts a canary controller can call /rollback when operator role is present.

meera: Thx. After patch let's also add an integration check in the rollout pipeline: after canary start, try a permission-gated rollback and ensure 2xx.

josh: Also add an alertable trace — if fallback endpoint returns 403 more than once in 5m during a rollout, auto-pause the rollout and notify on-call.

claire: Agree. Who owns the postmortem if this becomes P1? I'll draft initial summary.

arun: I can own the immediate patch + IAMPR. Assign me.

claire: :thumbsup: Assign to arun. I'll open the security ticket and link audit snippets. Meera can add the pipeline integration test.

security-bot: Created ticket SEC-2026-1147: "canary rollback blocked by RBAC/KMS drift" and added to triage queue.

claire: Cool. We'll track here and close once we have KMS grant + role change + pipeline test. Please paste PR links and IAMPR numbers in this thread.

meera: I'll post the integration test PR when ready.

josh: I'll add the alert rule draft to monitoring channel and link it back.

claire: Thanks everyone. :eyes:
